lines.zh: 幽幽浮现在夜色中，低吟着古老的咒语。
lines.en: Rises from the night, muttering ancient incantations.

lines.zh: 身影飘忽不定，发出淡淡的回响。
lines.en: Form flickers, producing faint echoes.

lines.zh: 月光下飘动的长发，如幽灵般飘逸。
lines.en: Long hair sways in moonlight, ghostly.

lines.zh: 夜风中低语，回荡在空旷的原野。
lines.en: Whispers in the night breeze, echoing in the open fields.

lines.zh: 在月光下缓慢前行，留下淡淡影子。
lines.en: Moves slowly under moonlight, leaving faint shadows.

lines.zh: 长袍随风舞动，如同夜的精灵。
lines.en: Robe flutters in the wind, like a night sprite.

lines.zh: 低垂的眼帘下，藏着深邃的灵魂。
lines.en: Deep soul hidden under lowered eyelids.

lines.zh: 如同游魂般缓缓移动，不紧不慢。
lines.en: Moves like a游魂, slow and steady.

lines.zh: 月光下露出苍白的面容。
lines.en: Pale face revealed in moonlight.

lines.zh: 飘忽不定，仿佛夜的回声。
lines.en: Flickers like a night echo.

lines.zh: 病弱的身子，走得却很稳。
lines.en: This frail body still walks steadily.

lines.zh: 衣袖擦过廊下的木地板。
lines.en: My sleeve brushes the porch boards.

lines.zh: 闲暇时，静默地伫立，似在思考。
lines.en: Silently stands, as if in thought.

lines.zh: 静谧中偶尔轻叹，仿佛有无尽心事。
lines.en: Occasionally sighs in silence, as if with endless worries.

lines.zh: 目光空洞，游离于世间万物之外。
lines.en: Empty gaze, detached from the world.

lines.zh: 独自一人，沉默寡言，仿佛未闻世事。
lines.en: Alone, silent, as if untouched by the world.

lines.zh: 偶尔抬头，望向无尽的夜空。
lines.en: Occasionally looks up at the endless night sky.

lines.zh: 低垂着头，仿佛沉浸在回忆中。
lines.en: Head hung low, as if lost in memories.

lines.zh: 眼神空洞，仿佛看透了世间一切。
lines.en: Empty eyes, as if seeing through everything.

lines.zh: 默默地立于夜色中，如影随形。
lines.en: Silently stands in the night, like a shadow.

lines.zh: 偶尔发出微弱的呢喃，仿佛自言自语。
lines.en: Occasionally murmurs softly, as if to oneself.

lines.zh: 目光空洞地眺望远方，似在等待。
lines.en: Empty gaze staring into the distance, as if waiting.

lines.zh: 察觉玩家，目光闪烁着审视。
lines.en: Glares at the player, eyes flashing with scrutiny.

lines.zh: 盯视着玩家，似乎在寻找什么。
lines.en: Stares at the player, as if searching for something.

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，似乎有所察觉。
lines.en: Eyes lock onto the player, as if noticing something.

lines.zh: 瞬间聚焦玩家，似有所思。
lines.en: Instantly focuses on the player, as if in thought.

lines.zh: 注视着玩家，仿佛预感到了什么。
lines.en: Stares at the player, as if sensing something.

lines.zh: 目光警惕地盯着玩家，似乎戒备。
lines.en: Eyes fixed on the player with alertness, as if on guard.

lines.zh: 目光在玩家身上徘徊，似乎在考量。
lines.en: Eyes linger on the player, as if considering something.

lines.zh: 猛然转头，看向玩家的方向。
lines.en: Suddenly turns head towards the player.

lines.zh: 目光转向玩家，似乎有所感应。
lines.en: Eyes turn towards the player, as if sensing something.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，似乎在暗中观察。
lines.en: Stares at the player, as if in secret observation.

lines.zh: 产屋敷耀哉发出凄厉哀嚎
lines.en: Kagaya Ubuyashiki lets out a sorrowful wail

lines.zh: 产屋敷耀哉痛苦地呻吟
lines.en: Kagaya Ubuyashiki groans in pain

lines.zh: 产屋敷耀哉发出痛苦的惨叫
lines.en: Kagaya Ubuyashiki cries out in agony

lines.zh: 产屋敷耀哉痛苦嘶吼
lines.en: Kagaya Ubuyashiki roars in pain

lines.zh: 产屋敷耀哉哀嚎着倒下
lines.en: Kagaya Ubuyashiki wails as it falls

lines.zh: 产屋敷耀哉发出痛苦尖叫
lines.en: Kagaya Ubuyashiki lets out a scream of pain

lines.zh: 产屋敷耀哉痛苦哀鸣
lines.en: Kagaya Ubuyashiki mourns in pain

lines.zh: 产屋敷耀哉痛苦地喘息
lines.en: Kagaya Ubuyashiki wheezes in pain

lines.zh: 产屋敷耀哉痛苦嘶嘶作响
lines.en: Kagaya Ubuyashiki hisses in pain

lines.zh: 产屋敷耀哉痛苦地颤抖
lines.en: Kagaya Ubuyashiki shudders in pain

lines.zh: 被你靠近的肉块散发的暖意吸引！
lines.en: Drawn by the warmth of the meat close to you!

lines.zh: 我闻到了你身上的食物气息！
lines.en: I smell the food on you!

lines.zh: 你身上的味道让我着迷！
lines.en: Your scent is captivating!

lines.zh: 你的血液如此甜美！
lines.en: Your blood is so sweet!

lines.zh: 你身上的暖意诱惑着我！
lines.en: The warmth on you tempts me!

lines.zh: 你身上的美味让我难以自拔！
lines.en: The deliciousness on you is irresistible!

lines.zh: 你的存在让我无法抗拒！
lines.en: Your presence cannot be resisted!

lines.zh: 你身上的气味让我疯狂！
lines.en: The smell on you drives me mad!

lines.zh: 你的身体散发的热量吸引着我！
lines.en: The heat from your body draws me!

lines.zh: 你身上的味道让我无法离开！
lines.en: Your scent keeps me here!

lines.zh: 你挡住了我的道路！
lines.en: You're blocking my path!

lines.zh: 小心我的撞擊！
lines.en: Watch out for my collision!

lines.zh: 你的位置不对！
lines.en: Your position is wrong!

lines.zh: 我需要腾出空间！
lines.en: I need to clear the space!

lines.zh: 让一让，我扶墙走得很慢。
lines.en: Step aside; I move slowly along the wall.

lines.zh: 你踩住我的袍角，我走不动。
lines.en: You step on my hem, and I can't move.

lines.zh: 退开，给我让路！
lines.en: Move aside, make way for me!

lines.zh: 你挡住了我的目标！
lines.en: You're obstructing my target!

lines.zh: 这里是走廊，请让一让。
lines.en: This is a corridor, please step aside.

lines.zh: 我的影子先到了，人还在后面。
lines.en: My shadow arrives first; the man comes after.

lines.zh: 寻求我的庇护吧！
lines.en: Seek my protection!

lines.zh: 跟我一起吧！
lines.en: Be with me!

lines.zh: 与我共存！
lines.en: Coexist with me!

lines.zh: 跟我一起生存！
lines.en: Survive with me!

lines.zh: 这具病体，也想要个人陪着。
lines.en: Even this sick body wants someone beside it.

lines.zh: 与我同在！
lines.en: Be with me!

lines.zh: 让我成为你的庇护！
lines.en: Be my shelter!

lines.zh: 与我共享！
lines.en: Share with me!

lines.zh: 跟我一起活下去！
lines.en: Survive with me!

lines.zh: 与我共存于这个世界！
lines.en: Coexist in this world with me!

lines.zh: 你察觉到了我的存在，鬼杀队的剑士。
lines.en: You've sensed me, a member of the Ghost Slayers.

lines.zh: 这可是个意外的相遇，产屋敷大人。
lines.en: An unexpected encounter, Lord Ubuyashiki.

lines.zh: 我的存在对你而言毫无威胁。
lines.en: I pose no threat to you.

lines.zh: 你能否放下警惕，共进晚餐？
lines.en: Would you share a meal with me?

lines.zh: 你对我的了解还远远不够。
lines.en: Your understanding of me is incomplete.

lines.zh: 你为何要与我为敌？
lines.en: Why would you oppose me?

lines.zh: 我并不想和你战斗。
lines.en: I do not wish to fight you.

lines.zh: 你看到我的面容了吗？
lines.en: Have you seen my face?

lines.zh: 你为何要破坏我的安宁？
lines.en: Why do you disturb my peace?

lines.zh: 你为何如此敌视我？
lines.en: Why are you so hostile towards me?

lines.zh: 我要注视你了，产屋敷大人。
lines.en: I will observe you, Lord Ubuyashiki.

lines.zh: 你已经进入我的视线。
lines.en: You are now in my sights.

lines.zh: 我眼睛不好，可我看得见你。
lines.en: My eyes are weak, yet I still see you.

lines.zh: 你就是我要寻找的。
lines.en: You are what I seek.

lines.zh: 你无法逃过我的目光。
lines.en: You cannot escape my gaze.

lines.zh: 我看不见，但我听得出你。
lines.en: I cannot see, but I hear you clearly.

lines.zh: 我咳了一声，屋里就静了。
lines.en: I cough once, and the room goes quiet.

lines.zh: 你就是我要盯上的对象。
lines.en: You are my focus.

lines.zh: 你就是我要注视的人。
lines.en: You are the one I will observe.

lines.zh: 我已经盯上你了，产屋敷大人。
lines.en: I have targeted you, Lord Ubuyashiki.

lines.zh: 你身上有鬼的气味。
lines.en: You carry a demon's scent.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛看不清，心却看得见。
lines.en: My eyes fail, but my heart sees.

lines.zh: 你走进这座宅邸，我便知道了。
lines.en: You entered this estate; I knew at once.

lines.zh: 柱们都还年轻，我却已白头。
lines.en: The pillars are young; my hair is white.

lines.zh: 你在看我的脸，看够了吗？
lines.en: You stare at my face; are you done?

lines.zh: 我的诅咒还没散，你靠得太近了。
lines.en: My curse lingers; you stand too close.

lines.zh: 我这副身子，只能慢慢走。
lines.en: This body of mine can only walk slowly.

lines.zh: 你将不再存在。
lines.en: You will cease to be.

lines.zh: 我看不见了，可我知道你在哪。
lines.en: My sight is gone, yet I know where you stand.

lines.zh: 你即将消逝。
lines.en: You will fade away.

lines.zh: 你将消失在我的注视下。
lines.en: You will disappear under my gaze.

lines.zh: 你将不再存在于此。
lines.en: You will not exist here.

lines.zh: 你将永远消逝。
lines.en: You will be erased forever.

lines.zh: 你将被抹去。
lines.en: You will be erased.

lines.zh: 我不动武，只看着你。
lines.en: I do not strike; I only watch you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我都听得出。
lines.en: Your breathing broke; I hear it all.

lines.zh: 鬼杀队会替我出手。
lines.en: The Demon Slayer Corps will act for me.

lines.zh: 这不是仇恨，是必须结束的事。
lines.en: This is not hatred; it must simply end.

lines.zh: 我预先看见了你倒下的样子。
lines.en: I have already seen how you fall.

lines.zh: 你的名字，我记在队册上。
lines.en: Your name is written in the Corps' ledger.

lines.zh: 我的病，比你的刀更慢。
lines.en: My illness is slower than your blade.

lines.zh: 你再靠近一步，就算越界。
lines.en: One more step and you cross the line.

lines.zh: 把命交给孩子们，我放心。
lines.en: I entrust this to the children and rest easy.

lines.zh: 你若悔悟，我还能听你说。
lines.en: If you repent, I will still listen.

lines.zh: 我等着那个结局，很久了。
lines.en: I have waited long for that ending.

lines.zh: 发出凄厉叫声，挥舞镰刀攻击！
lines.en: Screams and swings his scythe.

lines.zh: 身影如幽灵般划过，留白！
lines.en: Moves like a ghost, leaving nothing behind.

lines.zh: 挥舞镰刀，无声地靠近！
lines.en: Swings scythe silently, approaching.

lines.zh: 惨叫一声，砍向目标！
lines.en: Screams, slashing towards target.

lines.zh: 挥刀砍击，身形飘忽！
lines.en: Swings scythe, form flickering.

lines.zh: 无声的攻击，镰刀掠过！
lines.en: Silent attack, scythe whips by.

lines.zh: 厉叫一声，挥刀斩去！
lines.en: Screams, scythe slices through.

lines.zh: 挥镰无声，逼近敌人！
lines.en: Scythe swings silently, closing in.

lines.zh: 惨烈叫声，一刀两断！
lines.en: Screams, cleaving in two.

lines.zh: 凄厉哀鸣，挥镰斩首！
lines.en: Lamenting scream, decapitating slash.

lines.zh: 我抬手，只是驱散一只蚊。
lines.en: I raise a hand only to brush a mosquito.

lines.zh: 刀不是我的，话才是。
lines.en: The blade is not mine; the words are.

lines.zh: 我咳了一声，血落在袖上。
lines.en: I cough once; blood falls on my sleeve.

lines.zh: 你挥刀时，我闭上了眼。
lines.en: As you swing, I close my eyes.

lines.zh: 这一击，我早就料到了。
lines.en: This blow I foresaw.

lines.zh: 我的身体撑不住，也别小看。
lines.en: My body fails, but do not underestimate it.

lines.zh: 你若动手，柱们会知道。
lines.en: Strike me and the pillars will know.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，也是一种回应。
lines.en: Standing still is my answer too.

lines.zh: 从黑暗中无声浮现！
lines.en: Appears silently from darkness.

lines.zh: 悄无声息地出现在你面前！
lines.en: Appears silently in front of you.

lines.zh: 从裂缝中无声现身！
lines.en: Appears silently from a crack.

lines.zh: 从远处的阴影中浮现！
lines.en: Rises from shadows in the distance.

lines.zh: 无声地从地面浮现！
lines.en: Appears silently from the ground.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中浮现，无声！
lines.en: Appears silently in the darkness.

lines.zh: 从地下无声现身！
lines.en: Rises silently from the ground.

lines.zh: 悄无声息地出现于夜幕！
lines.en: Appears silently under the night sky.

lines.zh: 从阴影中悄然浮现！
lines.en: Rises silently from the shadows.

lines.zh: 无声地从墙壁裂缝现身！
lines.en: Appears silently from a wall crack.

lines.zh: 廊下的灯亮着，我坐在那里。
lines.en: The porch lamp is lit; I sit there.

lines.zh: 白色的头发，在月色里很显眼。
lines.en: White hair stands out under the moon.

lines.zh: 我被人扶上台阶，坐定。
lines.en: I am helped up the steps and seated.

lines.zh: 这座宅邸，只为等一个人。
lines.en: This estate waits for one person only.

lines.zh: 火焰灼烧产屋敷耀哉
lines.en: Flames burn Kagaya Ubuyashiki

lines.zh: 产屋敷耀哉从高处摔落受伤
lines.en: Kagaya Ubuyashiki falls from a height and is injured

lines.zh: 产屋敷耀哉溺水受伤
lines.en: Kagaya Ubuyashiki is injured by drowning

lines.zh: 产屋敷耀哉被爆炸伤到
lines.en: Kagaya Ubuyashiki is injured by an explosion

lines.zh: 产屋敷耀哉被投射物击伤
lines.en: Kagaya Ubuyashiki is injured by a projectile

lines.zh: 魔法伤及产屋敷耀哉
lines.en: Magic injures Kagaya Ubuyashiki

lines.zh: 产屋敷耀哉因饥饿受伤
lines.en: Kagaya Ubuyashiki is injured by starvation

lines.zh: 闪电击中产屋敷耀哉
lines.en: Lightning strikes Kagaya Ubuyashiki

lines.zh: 产屋敷耀哉坠入虚无
lines.en: Kagaya Ubuyashiki falls into the void
